newsitem.title: EGYPT: Brokers, officials elect board for Egypt bourse.
newsitem.headline: Brokers, officials elect board for Egypt bourse.

text.p: Brokers and officials on Wednesday said they had elected a new board for the Cairo stock exchange under a new system which allows them to choose only six members of the organisation's 11-member board

The six elected members are all brokers active in the market. They were named as Neveen el-Tahry of Delta-EAB, Hamdy el-Rashad of El Rashad Securities Brokerage, Aladdin Saba of Hermes EFG, Ibrahim Mokhtar of al-Rowad, ex-minister Fouad Sultan and broker Abdel Sattar Bakri.

Under the new system, established by presidential decree last month and which tightens government control over the bourse, the state will appoint the remaining members as well as the chairman of the exchange.
One member of the stock exchange board will represent the Central Bank of Egypt, one the Capital Market Authority (CMA) and two will represent banks.
The CMA has supervisory authority over the exchange.
In March, Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri appointed ex-banker Abdelghani Gamie to replace veteran broker Nassef Nazmi Girgis who was elected in 1995.
